sources.title: Seedream 4.0 - seed.bytedance.com
sources.snippet: As a new-generation image creation model, Seedream 4.0 integrates image generation and image editing capabilities into a single, unified architecture. This allows it to flexibly handle complex multimodal tasks, including knowledge-based generation, complex reasoning, and reference consistency.
